newsitem.title: UK: Guinness firms as broker repeats "buy".
newsitem.headline: Guinness firms as broker repeats "buy".

text.p: Shares in Guinness Plc moved higher on Thursday after SG Strauss Turnbull repeated its "buy" stance on the drinks and brewing group.

The twin attractions of a cheaply rated stock at the bottom end of the spirit industry's cycle and the possibility of a demerger of the group's operations were behind the recommendation, said SocGen analyst Steven Baird.

Guinness shares added 7p to 460p by early afternoon. If recent speculation over a possible break-up of Allied's businesses proved correct, said Baird, pressure for Guinness to make a similar move would increase.
"The splitting of its businesses into a stand alone spirits operation and brewing side would be attractive to any number of industry buyers," said Baird.

Rumours of a demerger of Guinness operations surfaced back in March, with with one newspaper quoting a Guinness insider as saying that the demerger option had already been discussed at board level and that the board was "not completely opposed to the idea".
